title: Machine learning predicts the small molecule TMEA as a thrombopoietin receptor agonist
summary: A machine learning model predicted the natural small molecule TMEA to promote megakaryocyte differentiation and thrombopoiesis. TMEA induced megakaryocyte differentiation phenotypes in zebrafish and in HEL and Meg-01 cells, DARTS, CETSA and molecular simulation pointed to the thrombopoietin receptor as its target, and its effects were examined in irradiated mice and Tpor knockout mice. The abstract does not describe the model details or quantitative effects.
